title: Present Perfect vs Past Simple
intro: **Past Simple** — действие закончилось в закрытом времени: _yesterday, last week, in 2019, two years ago, when I was a child_.
**Present Perfect** — результат важен сейчас или опыт без даты: _just, already, yet, ever, never, so far, recently_.
**Present Perfect** с _for / since_ — началось в прошлом и продолжается: _I've lived here since 2019_.
**Present Perfect Continuous** — подчёркивает процесс и длительность: _How long have you been waiting?_
Вопрос с **when** — всегда Past Simple: _When did you arrive?_

items.q: I ___ (live) here since 2019.
items.x: since + продолжается до сих пор → Present Perfect.

items.q: She ___ to London twice.
items.x: Опыт без указания времени → Present Perfect. has been = ездила и вернулась; has gone = уехала и ещё там.

items.q: I have seen him yesterday.
items.x: yesterday закрывает время → Past Simple.

items.q: When ___ the report?
items.x: Вопрос when спрашивает о моменте в прошлом → Past Simple.

items.q: We ___ (not / see) each other for ages.
items.x: for ages — период, который тянется до сейчас → Present Perfect.

a: Have you ever been to Japan?
items.x: ever ставится между have и причастием.

items.q: Shakespeare ___ many plays.
items.x: Человек умер — его период закрыт → Past Simple.

items.q: I ___ (just / hear) the news — it's terrible!
items.x: just + результат сейчас → Present Perfect.

items.q: I live in this flat for three years.
a: I have lived in this flat for three years.
I have been living in this flat for three years.
items.x: for + до сих пор → Present Perfect, не Present Simple.

items.q: How long have you ___ (wait)?
items.x: Длительность процесса до сейчас → Present Perfect Continuous.

items.q: Look! Somebody ___ the window.
items.x: Результат виден сейчас → Present Perfect.

items.q: The company ___ (open) three new offices last year.
items.x: last year → закрытый период → Past Simple.

a: I haven't finished the report yet.
items.x: yet ставится в конец отрицания.

items.q: This is the first time I ___ sushi.
items.x: It's the first time + Present Perfect.

items.q: When have you arrived?
items.x: С when используется Past Simple.

items.q: He ___ (work) here for ten years and still enjoys it.
items.x: Продолжается до сих пор → Present Perfect (Continuous).

items.q: She ___ (be) very busy lately.
items.x: lately / recently — период до сейчас → Present Perfect.

items.q: I ___ my keys. I can't get in.
items.x: Результат сейчас (не могу войти) → Present Perfect.

items.q: My grandfather has died in 1998.
items.x: Дата закрывает время → Past Simple.

a: She has been studying English since January.
items.x: since + точка отсчёта; процесс → Present Perfect Continuous.

items.q: ___ Thai food?
items.x: ever + опыт без даты → Present Perfect; после have — третья форма.

items.q: I ___ (read) this book twice, so I know it well.
items.x: Опыт с результатом сейчас → Present Perfect.

title: Прошедшие времена в повествовании
intro: **Past Simple** — цепочка событий по порядку: _He came in, sat down and opened the letter_.
**Past Continuous** — фон или процесс, который прервали: _I was watching TV when the phone rang_.
**Past Perfect** — случилось раньше другого события в прошлом; маркеры _by the time, after, before, already_: _The film had started by the time we arrived_.
**Past Perfect Continuous** — процесс до момента в прошлом, часто как причина: _She was tired because she had been working all day_.
**used to** — прошлая привычка или состояние, которых больше нет.

items.q: By the time we arrived, the film ___ (start).
items.x: by the time → раньше другого прошлого события → Past Perfect.

items.q: I ___ TV when the phone rang.
items.x: Процесс-фон, который прервало событие → Past Continuous.

items.q: When I got home, I saw that someone broke the window.
a: When I got home, I saw that someone had broken the window.
items.x: Окно разбили раньше, чем я пришёл → Past Perfect.

a: She had never seen snow before.
items.x: never между had и причастием; before отсылает к моменту в прошлом.

items.q: We ___ (walk) for two hours when it started to rain.
items.x: Длительный процесс до момента в прошлом → Past Perfect Continuous.

items.q: He ___ his leg while he was skiing.
items.x: Короткое событие на фоне процесса → Past Simple.

items.q: I ___ football every weekend when I was a kid.
items.x: Прошлая привычка → used to + инфинитив.

items.q: After she ___ (finish) her degree, she moved to Berlin.
items.x: after делает порядок ясным, поэтому возможны и Past Perfect, и Past Simple.

items.q: While I was cooking dinner, the lights had gone out.
a: While I was cooking dinner, the lights went out.
items.x: Событие на фоне процесса → Past Simple, не Past Perfect.

items.q: She was tired because she ___ all day.
items.x: Причина — процесс до момента в прошлом → Past Perfect Continuous.

items.q: The train ___ (leave) by the time I got to the station.
items.x: by the time + Past Simple → раньше → Past Perfect.

a: What were you doing at 8 last night?
items.x: Вопрос о процессе в момент прошлого → Past Continuous.

items.q: It was the best meal I ___ (ever / eat).
items.x: Превосходная степень в прошлом + опыт до того момента → Past Perfect.

items.q: As soon as he was opening the door, the dog ran out.
a: As soon as he opened the door, the dog ran out.
As soon as he had opened the door, the dog ran out.
items.x: as soon as — последовательность событий, а не процесс.

items.q: They ___ (not / know) each other long when they got married.
items.x: Состояние до момента в прошлом → Past Perfect.

items.q: When I ___ the room, everyone stopped talking.
items.x: Событие, после которого произошло другое → Past Simple.

items.q: I ___ (drive) home when I realised I had left my phone at work.
items.x: Процесс в момент, когда что-то произошло → Past Continuous.

items.q: I didn't went to school yesterday.
a: I didn't go to school yesterday.
items.x: После didn't — начальная форма глагола.

a: He had been waiting for an hour before she came.
items.x: Длительность до события в прошлом → Past Perfect Continuous.

items.q: She looked familiar — I was sure I ___ (meet) her somewhere before.
items.x: Раньше момента в прошлом → Past Perfect.

items.q: In those days people ___ letters, not emails.
items.x: Прошлая привычка, которой больше нет → used to.

items.q: The streets were wet. It ___ (rain).
items.x: Результат в прошлом от предшествующего процесса → Past Perfect (Continuous).

title: Способы говорить о будущем
intro: **will** — решение в момент речи, обещание, прогноз-мнение: _I'll get it. I think it will rain_.
**going to** — намерение (решение уже принято) или прогноз по видимым признакам: _Look at the clouds — it's going to rain_.
**Present Continuous** — договорённость с временем и местом: _I'm meeting Tom at 5_.
После **when, if, as soon as, until, before** — настоящее время, не will: _I'll call you when I arrive_.
**Future Continuous** — процесс в момент в будущем; **Future Perfect** — завершится к сроку: _by Friday, by 2030_.

items.q: Look at those clouds! It ___.
items.x: Прогноз по видимым признакам → going to.

items.q: I'll call you when I ___ (arrive).
items.x: После when — Present Simple, не will.

items.q: If it will rain tomorrow, we will stay at home.
a: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
items.x: После if — настоящее время.

items.q: — The phone's ringing. — I ___ get it.
items.x: Спонтанное решение в момент речи → will.

a: We're having dinner with Anna on Friday.
items.x: Договорённость с датой → Present Continuous.

items.q: The train ___ (leave) at 6.45 tomorrow morning.
items.x: Расписание → Present Simple.

items.q: By 2030 the company ___ 50 offices.
items.x: by + момент в будущем → Future Perfect.

items.q: This time next week I ___ (lie) on a beach.
items.x: Процесс в конкретный момент будущего → Future Continuous.

items.q: Don't leave until I will come back.
a: Don't leave until I come back.
items.x: После until — настоящее время.

items.q: We ___ a new house. We've already found one we like.
items.x: Намерение, решение уже принято → going to.

items.q: I promise I ___ (not / tell) anyone.
items.x: Обещание → will.

a: She is going to start a new job in May.
items.x: Намерение / план → going to.

items.q: I ___ Tom at the airport at 5. He's expecting me.
items.x: Договорённость с временем и местом → Present Continuous.

items.q: As soon as the report ___ (be) ready, I'll send it to you.
items.x: После as soon as — Present Simple.

items.q: We will have finish the project by Friday.
a: We will have finished the project by Friday.
items.x: Future Perfect = will have + третья форма.

items.q: Don't worry, I ___ (help) you with the boxes.
items.x: Предложение помощи, решение сейчас → will.

items.q: What time ___ tomorrow?
items.x: Расписание → вопрос в Present Simple.

items.q: I ___ (finish) the essay by Sunday, so we can meet on Monday.
items.x: by Sunday → Future Perfect.

a: I'll let you know as soon as I hear anything.
items.x: После as soon as — настоящее время.

items.q: — Have you decided? — Yes, we ___ to Spain in July.
items.x: Решённый план с датой → Present Continuous.

items.q: He ___ (probably / be) late — he always is.
items.x: Прогноз-мнение → will; probably ставится после will.

items.q: Wait here until the doctor will call your name.
a: Wait here until the doctor calls your name.
items.x: После until — настоящее время.
